description:
This file defines the academic progress tracking structure for citizen nwo-citizen0001, Pat Tarwater Jr, as part of the Information Technology program at South University. It is designed for integration into Beast System 3.0 as a deterministic artifact that records academic milestones, course completions, GPA updates, advisor interactions, and long-term progression toward graduation. No sensitive personal identifiers are stored within this file, ensuring compliance and security.

The progress tracking structure includes the following phases: Phase 1: Term Initialization, documenting the start of each academic term, enrolled courses, and expected workload. Phase 2: Course-Level Tracking, providing fields for assignment completion, exam performance, project submissions, and instructor feedback. Phase 3: Skill Integration Mapping, linking completed coursework to Beast System 3.0 development goals, DAO governance needs, and organizational leadership competencies. Phase 4: Advisor Interaction Logging, recording advising sessions, recommendations, academic adjustments, and long-term planning updates. Phase 5: GPA and Performance Monitoring, documenting term GPA, cumulative GPA, academic standing, and any honors or recognitions. Phase 6: Milestone Completion, tracking major academic achievements such as foundational course completion, specialization progress, capstone preparation, and readiness for graduation.

This file serves as a canonical reference for Beast System 3.0 academic modules, ensuring that educational progression remains aligned with organizational growth, technical expansion, and long-term governance objectives. It does not automate academic tracking; instead, it provides a deterministic structure that the citizen manually updates to maintain accuracy and compliance.
